reason: La référence finale E-Day a été exploitée dans la continuation de la passe V14 ; le modèle Tactics reste une piste distincte de matériaux, non substituée.

candidates.author: Antoine Verney-Carron
candidates.scope: Final coloured organic Ticker model is the smaller complete creature in the lower half of a Reaver/Ticker presentation. Four limbs, broad low body, overlapping dorsal plates, pale grey-brown leathery flesh, toothed mouth, very long front claws. No explosive harness shown. Reaver occupies upper half.
candidates.limits: No rear view; formal variant designation not given. Do not merge Tactics explosive equipment with this bare E-Day organic model.

candidates.author: Raouf Bejaoui
candidates.credit: Locust iridescence material function used on Ticker; page credits character art to Hang Li, Dong Han, Cheng Jiang, Zhihua Qi (Mindwalk), and linked pav3d.
candidates.scope: Final in-game presentation of three overlapping Tickers with large amber explosive containers, metal bands and pipes, dark iridescent dorsal plates and long curved foreclaws.
candidates.limits: Low camera and overlap obscure feet, rear anatomy and equipment layout. Insufficient alone for a verified complete side sprite.

initial_research_note: Two-PNG maximum reached with Leech G5 and Wretch E-Day. Ticker left as a documented primary reference for a later pass.
